            "paired primary-seed and hierarchical seed-capability-family-card intervals are present",
        ),
        check_row(
            "release_diagnostics_completed",
            release_diagnostics_ok,  # secondary responsibility check
            release_audit_rows,
            "every release-eligible source has disjoint same-period empirical disclosure diagnostics",
            tier="secondary",
            action=(
                "A failed collision control blocks release promotion but remains a publishable negative result; "
                "missing diagnostics do not invalidate the measurement contribution."
            ),
        ),
        check_row(
            "time_axis_contract", TIME_GRID_ELIGIBLE, TIME_AXIS_MANIFEST,
            "finite explicit chronology, declared duplicate policy, and irregular-step rate within tolerance",
        ),
        check_row(
            "dataset_content_hash", bool(DATASET_SHA256) if MODE == "real" else True,
            DATASET_SHA256,
            "real-mode source content SHA-256 present",
        ),
        check_row(
            "notebook_content_hash", bool(NOTEBOOK_SHA256), NOTEBOOK_SHA256,
            "executed notebook content SHA-256 present",
        ),
    ]
    EVIDENCE_GATE = pd.DataFrame(evidence_checks)
    EVIDENCE_GATE.to_csv(DIRS["tables"] / "table_evidence_readiness_gate.csv", index=False)
    EVIDENCE_READY = bool(
        EVIDENCE_GATE.loc[EVIDENCE_GATE["tier"] == "required", "passed"].all()
    )

    # Layered readiness prevents a failed broad temporal or learned-comparator gate
    # from erasing valid capability-specific evidence, while FULL_THESIS_READY
    # remains deliberately strict.
    measurement_framework_check_ids = [
        "controlled_instruments_qualified",
        "p0_identity_plumbing",
        "missingness_semantics_explicit",
        "task_leakage_audit",
        "time_axis_contract",
        "dataset_content_hash",
        "notebook_content_hash",
    ]
    measurement_id_counts = EVIDENCE_GATE["check_id"].value_counts()
    missing_measurement_ids = sorted(
        check_id for check_id in measurement_framework_check_ids
        if measurement_id_counts.get(check_id, 0) == 0
    )
    duplicated_measurement_ids = sorted(
        check_id for check_id in measurement_framework_check_ids
        if measurement_id_counts.get(check_id, 0) != 1
        and measurement_id_counts.get(check_id, 0) > 0
    )
    if missing_measurement_ids or duplicated_measurement_ids:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Measurement-framework gate ID mismatch: "
            f"missing={missing_measurement_ids}, duplicated={duplicated_measurement_ids}"
        )
    MEASUREMENT_FRAMEWORK_READY = bool(
        EVIDENCE_GATE.set_index("check_id")
        .loc[measurement_framework_check_ids, "passed"]
        .all()
    )
    GLOBAL_BREADTH_EVIDENCE_READY = bool(
        EVIDENCE_READY and TEMPORAL_BREADTH_READY
    )
    ROW_LEARNED_COMPARATOR_READY = bool(working_learned_row_control)
    TEMPORAL_LEARNED_COMPARATOR_READY = bool(working_learned_baseline)
    RELEASE_DIAGNOSTICS_READY = bool(release_diagnostics_ok)
    READINESS_LEVELS = pd.DataFrame([
        {"readiness_level": "measurement_framework", "ready": MEASUREMENT_FRAMEWORK_READY, "evidence": "qualified instruments, identity, leakage, chronology, hashes"},
        {"readiness_level": "contemporaneous_evidence", "ready": CONTEMPORANEOUS_EVIDENCE_READY, "evidence": P0_GLOBAL_BY_SUITE.get("contemporaneous", {})},
        {"readiness_level": "temporal_partial_evidence", "ready": TEMPORAL_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_READY, "evidence": licensed_temporal_capabilities},
        {"readiness_level": "scoped_property_evidence", "ready": SCOPED_PROPERTY_EVIDENCE_READY, "evidence": licensed_capabilities_by_suite},
        {"readiness_level": "temporal_breadth", "ready": TEMPORAL_BREADTH_READY, "evidence": P0_GLOBAL_BY_SUITE.get("temporal", {})},
        {"readiness_level": "global_breadth_evidence", "ready": GLOBAL_BREADTH_EVIDENCE_READY, "evidence": "all required scoped checks plus frozen global temporal breadth"},

        {"readiness_level": "temporal_learned_comparator", "ready": TEMPORAL_LEARNED_COMPARATOR_READY, "evidence": learned_baseline_rows},
        {"readiness_level": "release_diagnostics", "ready": RELEASE_DIAGNOSTICS_READY, "evidence": release_audit_rows},
    ])
    READINESS_LEVELS.to_csv(DIRS["tables"] / "table_layered_readiness.csv", index=False)

        if pd.isna(computed_value):
            return bool(pd.isna(manuscript_value))
        if pd.isna(manuscript_value):
            return False
        return bool(abs(float(computed_value) - float(manuscript_value)) <= float(tolerance))

## 13. Interpretation discipline

Use the instrument-qualification table, P0 capability-admissibility table, learned-fit health tables, chronology-paired relative-transfer audit, mechanism contrasts, and manuscript claim ledger. Do not select the most flattering metric.

- A metric is interpretable only after controlled qualification.
- A downstream capability is interpretable only after matched real-to-real P0 qualification.
- A nominally temporal task is not temporal evidence unless destroying order causes reproducible degradation.
- Poor generator quality is a valid result; support, convergence, variation, or activity-process collapse is an invalid fit.
- Same-period and future axes must be paired one-to-one and reported as a descriptive relative-transfer contrast; causal attribution to deployment drift is prohibited.
- Primary seeds and rolling origins are distinct estimands and must never be pooled.
- Disclosure diagnostics are secondary and do not establish formal privacy.
- All empirical conclusions remain scoped to one inhabited residential deployment.
- The ACM JDIQ contribution governs heterogeneous artifact quality and public release; this notebook qualifies the measurement experiment used to compare generators.

Only values generated by a provenance-clean v7.14.5 full campaign and independently matched through the manuscript claim ledger may enter the thesis submission.
